Classes.title: Our Classes
Classes.bjjKidsDesc: Gladius Club is the central Tbilisi club of the Georgian National Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Federation, where a special unified development program has been created for children.
Classes.bjjAdultsDesc: Gi is the traditional form of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, focused on technical precision, positional control, and strategic thinking. No-Gi is a fast-paced and dynamic style that closely reflects real-life conditions.

KidsProgram.title: Kids Program
KidsProgram.description: Our kids program focuses on building confidence, discipline, and physical fitness through Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. Children learn self-defense skills in a safe, supportive environment while developing coordination, teamwork, and respect.

AdultsBjj.title: Adult Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu
AdultsBjj.description: Train Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for adults in both Gi and No-Gi formats. Our program is designed for all skill levels, from complete beginners to advanced practitioners. Learn effective grappling techniques, improve your fitness, and join our supportive community.

Masterclass.title: Masterclass
Masterclass.description:
Krav Maga Masterclasses (Self-Defense)
I conduct practical Krav Maga masterclasses for various organizations, companies, and security services. The programs are designed around real-life threats and focus on improving employee safety and preparedness.

Masterclasses are suitable for:
- Corporate organizations
- Security and protection services
- Educational and specialized programs

The program includes:
- Responses to real-life attacks
- Defense against armed and unarmed attackers
- Effective actions under stress
- Team coordination and situational awareness

Benefits for the organizer:
- Improved employee safety
- A practical and professional training program
- Increased team motivation and responsibility

Results for employees:
- Increased self-confidence
- Ability to react effectively in critical situations
- Improved stress management
- Practical skills applicable in daily life

Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Masterclasses
I conduct Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu masterclasses for organizations focused on the physical and mental development of their teams. The program is based on control, balance, and strategic thinking.

Ideal for:
- Corporate teams
- Security and special services
- Sports and educational projects

The program includes:
- Body control and safe grappling techniques
- Efficient use of strength
- Development of focus and discipline
- Teamwork skills

Benefits for the organizer:
- Increased physical and mental resilience of employees
- Stronger team cohesion
- A unique and non-standard training format

Results for employees:
- Better body control
- Reduced stress levels
- Improved concentration
- Enhanced physical fitness and mental toughness

About.aboutDescription: GLADIUS is a martial arts school located in Tbilisi, Georgia. We specialize in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ), Krav Maga, and MMA. Our experienced coaches are dedicated to providing high-quality training for all levels, from beginners to advanced practitioners. We believe in creating a supportive and inclusive environment where everyone can learn and grow.

Coaches.title: Our Coaches
Coaches.coach1Role: Founder & Head Coach – Club Gladius | President of the Georgian Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu National Federation | Co-Founder of the Georgian Jiu-Jitsu Tour | Jiu-Jitsu Black Belt 2011–2025 (1st–6th Dan) | Since 2026 – Shihan | World Champion
Coaches.coach1Description:
Giorgi Oboladze is one of the pioneers of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu in Georgia and one of the leading figures in the development of this sport in the country. He was the first to begin the systematic development of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu in Georgia and founded a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu academy in 2014. Since 2023, he has served as the President of the Georgian Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu National Federation and is one of the founders of the Georgian Jiu-Jitsu Tour (2022) — a platform that has played a significant role in establishing a professional and competitive Jiu-Jitsu environment in Georgia.

In 2014, Giorgi Oboladze founded Club Gladius, which today is recognized as one of the leading combat sports academies in Georgia. As the head coach, he has developed a high-level technical, physical, and mental training system based on discipline, strategy, and continuous improvement.

Giorgi Oboladze holds a 6th Dan Black Belt in Jiu-Jitsu and is a World Champion in Japanese Jiu-Jitsu, as well as the winner of numerous international tournaments. He is a professional Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu instructor, a professional instructor of the special Krav Maga program, and the author of implementing this system within the educational field. He has many years of experience in special physical preparation and tactical professional training.

Alongside his sporting career, he serves as the Chief Specialist for Construction, Standardization, and Occupational Safety at SOCAR Georgia Gas nationwide. Giorgi Oboladze holds higher education degrees and is currently a doctoral candidate. His professional activity combines athletic achievements, instruction, and strategic leadership, making him one of the leading figures in combat sports in Georgia.
